text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna make tons of wishes 
so I can get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
First, let's look at the notes I 
prepared... They say it's best to be as 
specific and detailed as possible with 
your wishes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? The handwriting's so wobbly I 
can't read it!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... Oh, right. I need to list down 
all my wishes for the gods...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm... strong enough... to pull a "heavy 
tire"...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh? "Black cur-ry..."? I can't read 
this at aaaaall~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser couldn't get her wish 
through to the gods...
